caption: The drawing depicts a single, highly detailed teapot positioned centrally on a plain, light background. The teapot is rendered in shades of gray, giving it a metallic appearance, and features a tall, slender spout extending to the left and a curved handle extending to the right, which appears to be made of a darker material, possibly wood or ebony. The body of the teapot is faceted with vertical panels, and it rests on three short, rounded feet. A domed lid with a decorative finial tops the teapot. There is an engraved or etched circular medallion on the side, featuring ornate script initials. The upper rim and the bottom edge of the teapot are adorned with subtle decorative borders. The lighting and shading emphasize the reflective, polished surface of the teapot. The background is plain and unadorned, focusing all attention on the teapot itself.
title: Silver Teapot
